title: Groupon data collection — purposes & safeguards
summary: Comparison of data types Groupon collects against commercial purposes and security controls. Each cell indicates whether that data type is used for the given purpose, as stated in the Groupon Privacy Statement.

items.description: Groupon uses personal info to customize site experience and service recommendations.
Groupon uses contact info for promotional e-mails; users may opt out.
Personal info may be shared with Business Partners for Other Programs; scope depends on enrollment.
Administrative, technical, and physical controls safeguard personal information.
Payment data is used for transaction processing, not for personalization.
Financial account information is not used for marketing communications.
Financial account data is not shared with Business Partners.
Industry-standard encryption is applied specifically to Financial Account Information.
Browsing and purchase history are used to recommend deals and personalize the site.
Past purchase behavior informs targeted promotional e-mails.
Aggregate behavioral data may be shared with advertising partners and vendors.
General information security program applies; no specific behavioral-data controls are described.

evidence_links.passage: We will collect information, including Personal Information and Non-Identifying Information, when you interact with us and the Site, for example when you: access or use the Site; register, subscribe, or create an account with Groupon; open or respond to our e-mails; purchase products or services on or through the Site.

We (or our Vendors on our behalf), use information collected as described in this Privacy Statement to: Operate, maintain and improve the Site and our services; provide you with a personalized experience on our Site; send you promotional communications.
provide information to enroll or participate in Other Programs provided on behalf of, or together with, Business Partners; visit any page online that displays our ads or content.

Groupon has implemented an information security program that contains administrative, technical and physical controls that are designed to reasonably safeguard Personal Information. For example, we use industry-standard encryption technology to secure Financial Account Information.

limitations: The 'Permitted' classification for partner sharing reflects the policy's broad language; actual sharing scope depends on user enrollment in 'Other Programs'.
Groupon's cookie and tracking practices are described separately and are not captured in this matrix.
Security controls are described qualitatively; no specific certifications (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) are mentioned.
fallback_text: Groupon collects personal information (name, contact), financial information (payment), and behavioral data (browsing, purchases). Personal and behavioral data are used for personalization, e-mail marketing, and may be shared with partners. Financial data receives the strongest security controls (encryption) but is not used for marketing. General security controls apply across all data types.

_source.query: Consider 'Groupon''s privacy policy; what does Groupon do with collected data, and what security controls are in place?
_source.generated_answer: Groupon collects personal information, financial data, and behavioral data. It uses this information to operate and personalize its services, send promotional communications, and share with business partners for affiliated programs. Financial Account Information is specifically protected with industry-standard encryption. A broader information security program with administrative, technical, and physical controls applies to all Personal Information.
